# Coursera

> > Coursera is a leading online learning platform offering courses, professional certificates, and degree programs from top universities and technology companies including Google, IBM, Microsoft, OpenAI, and Stanford.

Coursera provides accessible online education across multiple learning formats, from individual courses to full Master's degrees, with specialized solutions for businesses, governments, and higher education institutions. The platform emphasizes career development, AI and data science education, and workforce upskilling through partnerships with industry leaders and prestigious universities.

## Key Topics

- Professional Certificates
- Generative AI
- Data Science
- Machine Learning
- Google Certificates
- Online Degrees
- Career Development
- Computer Science
- Business Skills
- IBM Courses
- Microsoft Certificates
- OpenAI
- Coursera Plus
- University Partnerships
- Workforce Development

## Core Learning Platforms

- [Coursera Homepage](https://www.coursera.org): Coursera homepage offering online courses, certificates, and degrees from Google, IBM, Microsoft, and universities.
- [Coursera for Business](https://www.coursera.org/business): Enterprise platform for workforce upskilling with AI-powered learning solutions and professional development.
- [Coursera Campus](https://www.coursera.org/campus): Solution for higher education institutions with professional certificates and guided projects.
- [Coursera for Government](https://www.coursera.org/government): E-learning platform for public sector workforce development and digital upskilling.

## Degrees and Certifications

- [Online Degree Programs](https://www.coursera.org/degrees): Online degree programs from top universities including iMBA and Master of Science in Computer Science.
- [Google Professional Certificates](https://www.coursera.org/google-career-certificates): Google professional certificates in UX design, project management, data analytics, and IT support.
- [Microsoft Certificates](https://www.coursera.org/explore/microsoft-certificates): Microsoft certificates and courses on Microsoft 365, Excel, and Power BI for career advancement.
- [Career Academy](https://www.coursera.org/career-academy): Guides learners through job roles and professional certificates with career path exploration.

## AI and Data Science Courses

- [Generative AI Courses](https://www.coursera.org/explore/generative-ai): 300+ AI and generative AI courses from Google, OpenAI, Anthropic, Microsoft, and IBM.
- [DeepLearning.AI Courses](https://www.coursera.org/explore/deep-learning-ai-online-courses): Expert-led courses on machine learning, deep learning, and generative AI by Andrew Ng.
- [IBM Online Courses](https://www.coursera.org/explore/ibm-online-courses): IBM online courses on AI, machine learning, data science, and cloud computing from industry experts.
- [Most Popular Courses](https://www.coursera.org/explore/most-popular-courses): Discovery page showcasing most popular courses in AI, data science, and computer science.

## University and Industry Partnerships

- [University of Illinois Urbana-Champaign](https://www.coursera.org/partners/illinois): Master's degrees in computer science and MBA programs from University of Illinois.
- [Stanford University Courses](https://www.coursera.org/explore/stanford-online-courses): Stanford online courses on machine learning, AI, business, and data science from renowned faculty.
- [University of Pennsylvania Courses](https://www.coursera.org/explore/university-of-pennsylvania-online-courses): University of Pennsylvania and Wharton School courses on business, law, and psychology.
- [University of Michigan Courses](https://www.coursera.org/explore/university-of-michigan-online-courses): University of Michigan courses including Python for Everybody and data science specializations.
- [OpenAI Courses](https://www.coursera.org/partners/openai): OpenAI courses featuring ChatGPT education and artificial general intelligence learning resources.
- [Anthropic Courses](https://www.coursera.org/partners/anthropic): Anthropic AI safety courses including Claude training and real-world AI fundamentals specialization.

## Business and Professional Skills

- [Business Skills Courses](https://www.coursera.org/explore/business-skills): Curated business skills courses in marketing, HR, finance with job-ready credentials and certifications.
- [Business Course Catalog](https://www.coursera.org/browse/business): Business course catalog covering project management, marketing, leadership, and entrepreneurship.
